question: If Kar stops asking the local 7B to do judgement, and instead routes each job to the tier that can do it — the job's own code when an organ does it, the local model for narrow wording jobs, Claude on Simon's own login for judgement — inside a nightly budget it cannot cross, does Kar's nightly idea become something a busy owner could act on, at a cost that stays bounded, and does Kar say plainly when it had to fall back?
why: Simon (2026-10-26): Kar on a local 7B/14B is unreliable because a small model cannot do the hard reasoning; Kar should be the persistent conductor that calls Claude for judgement, uses the local models as reflexes, and runs organs directly. The nightly loop's build idea was the 7B's job; it produced stitched names and a repeated template (kar-night-repair, 2026-10-22).

tiers.deterministic: a job an organ does: run it; no model
tiers.local: a narrow wording job (classify, summarise, extract, format, draft a short line, tag, shorten, name, rewrite plainly): the local model
tiers.frontier: judgement (propose, decide, choose, review, plan, design, write code, diagnose, judge, coordinate, prioritise): Claude on Simon's own login, through the official CLI with no tools, no MCP servers, nothing saved, run from an empty folder so no memory rides in uninvited; Kar hands it the focused context itself

design.unsure: a job in words the router does not recognise goes to the frontier while tonight's budget allows (Claude when unsure, per the spec), else to the local model, marked as a fallback
design.budget: a nightly wallet (the shared foundation's wallet kernel, vendored from fall-kit/core): a frontier call is made only if its whole token ceiling still fits tonight; the ceiling is spent up front, so tonight's total can never pass the budget
design.frontierModel: the newest Claude model the installed CLI serves on Simon's login (claude-opus-4-8 on 2026-10-26)
design.localModel: the biggest local model that fits free memory (local-wire.mjs; qwen2.5:7b on this laptop at night)

routing.note: Thirty jobs in plain words, ten per tier, written before the router. The router reads the words only.

ideas.note: Six pairs the dream graph surfaced on 2026-10-26 (day 18; its 'connected' and 'recurring' lists, public repos only — si-didy is private and is left out of a public receipt). Each pair gets the SAME prompt and the SAME answer shape on both tiers: { idea, uses, firstStep, why }. The local model's reply is read as JSON; the frontier's comes back in the CLI's structured output.

checks.shaped: an object with idea (at least 20 characters), uses (a list), firstStep (at least 6 words) and why (at least 10 characters)
checks.grounded: every name in uses is a public repo in the estate index, and uses names at least one of the pair
checks.plain: no frame words anywhere in it: +1, wobble, θ, κ, φ, regulat…, kappa, phi
checks.concrete: the first step names one of the pair
checks.fresh: not the old template ("bundled with … paired offer"), and no two ideas in a run share more than 60% of their words

ideas.passes: an idea passes when it meets all five checks

claims.claim: The router puts each job on the tier it belongs on.
claims.measure: the thirty sealed jobs, routed from their words alone with budget left
claims.holds_if: at least 27 of 30 on the sealed tier

claims.claim: The budget is a wall: tonight's frontier calls can never total more than tonight's budget.
claims.measure: a night with a budget of 100,000 tokens and a ceiling of 30,000 per call, asked for six calls; then the next night
claims.holds_if: exactly three calls authorised, the fourth to sixth refused before any call is made and routed to the local model marked as a fallback, and the next night starts fresh

claims.claim: The frontier only thinks: it is given no tools and no servers, and uses none.
claims.measure: every frontier call in the idea run: the CLI's own report
claims.holds_if: every call reports one turn, no permission denials and no tool use

claims.claim: Kar's nightly idea, made on the frontier, is one a busy owner could act on.
claims.measure: the six sealed pairs on the frontier tier, judged by the five checks

claims.claim: The same job on the local 7B passes fewer of the same checks.
claims.measure: the six sealed pairs on the local tier, same prompt, same checks
claims.holds_if: the local model passes at least 2 fewer than the frontier

claims.claim: When the frontier cannot be reached, Kar falls back to the local model and says so.
claims.measure: an idea asked for with the frontier's CLI made unreachable
claims.holds_if: the idea is made on the local tier and its record says it fell back and why; nothing is recorded as frontier

claims.claim: It stays cheap: the six frontier ideas together cost a bounded number of tokens.
claims.measure: the CLI's reported tokens (input, cache and output) summed over the six frontier calls
